name: Glass Bridge Pavilions — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Circular marble pavilion with very open slender column bays, turquoise/clear glass dome on fine gold ribs, flower garlands and a central pond/fountain. Source palette is delicate glass/gold/marble, not another enclosed domed tower. Hidden layout inference: Set pavilion just off the bridge's main through lane or split the route around its central pool, maintaining one clear continuous passage. Create a small shaded rest ring with views through columns; fountain and plants stay inside the ring. Reuse at distinct bridge stops rather than designing each anew. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B20-STRUCT-001 — Glass Bridge Pavilions — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need radial floor/column/ring-beam hosts, glass dome segment interfaces and bridge/pavilion entry transition. Existing dome rib, marble rail, garland and fountain motifs already shown; maintain open bays. Planter flowers/nearby lilies, butterflies/dragonflies and optional pond fish; passage clearances unverified. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.

B20-STRUCT-001-S01 — Radial column bay. Dimensions W,D,H [8, 6, 12]m proposed. One isolated radial column bay matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
